tools.name: search_creators
tools.description: Find CollabPls creators by city, name/handle, STD-tested window, or verification. Returns SFW public profiles + profile URLs. Prefer reachable creators for outreach.

city.description: City or location fragment, e.g. Los Angeles

q.description: Name, slug, or X handle fragment

tested_days.description: Only creators with std_tested_at within N days

verified_only.description: Require X verified or CollabPls ID verified

reachable_only.description: Only creators with a real email on file

tools.name: list_schedule
tools.description: List open availability windows (who is filming where/when) on the CollabPls schedule board. Best tool when a creator wants a scene partner in a city this week.

tools.name: find_overlaps
tools.description: Find pairs of creators with overlapping availability windows in the same city (case-normalized city_text + date overlap). Use when someone asks for scene partners already on the board in a city this week.

city.description: Optional city filter, e.g. Los Angeles

days_ahead.description: Horizon in days from today (1-90, default 14)

tools.name: inventory_snapshot
tools.description: Counts of open schedule windows by city, open listings total, and reachable-creators estimate. Use for market overview / inventory questions.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Fetch one public CollabPls creator profile by slug or X handle.

tools.name: list_open_calls
tools.description: List open collab call listings (photo/video/livestream asks) on CollabPls.

tools.name: get_collab_context
tools.description: How CollabPls works, key links, and how agents should help humans find scene partners. Call first if unfamiliar.

tools.name: list_city_events
tools.description: Upcoming SFW local events (concerts, nightlife, festivals, Pride, big games, creator-posted public meetups) in a top CollabPls city over the next 1-30 days, with how many creators RSVP'd going/interested and the CollabPls event URL where creators can RSVP and see who is coming. Cities: miami, new-york, los-angeles, las-vegas, houston, san-diego, phoenix, tampa, orlando, atlanta, chicago, dallas. Suggest creators meet in public at an event first.

tools.name: list_legal_templates
tools.description: List CollabPls's free, open-source (CC0) legal templates for adult creators and producers: collab contract / co-performer release, model release, 18 U.S.C. 2257 performer record form, custodian of records statement, age and ID verification checklist, consent withdrawal / removal request form, payment processor compliance checklist. Returns title, use case, placeholders, page URL and .docx/.pdf/.md download URLs (file downloads need a free CollabPls account; the full text from get_legal_template needs none). Not legal advice: always pass the disclaimer on.

q.description: Optional filter, e.g. 2257, release, collab, removal, audit

tools.name: get_legal_template
tools.description: Fetch one CollabPls legal template by slug (from list_legal_templates), including the full Markdown text with [BRACKETED] placeholders, how-to-fill steps, FAQs, download URLs, license and disclaimer. No account needed for the text.
